reel.title: The email side of Message in a Bottle

scenes.title: Bottle email
scenes.caption: What Bottle's email can do, and what it takes.
scenes.say: Ahoy, captain. Here's the email side of Message in a Bottle: what it sends, what works without it, and what switching it on costs.

picture.sub: what it does, what it costs

scenes.title: Four emails
scenes.caption: Bottle can send four kinds of email.
scenes.say: Bottle can send four emails. An invitation, a sign in link, news of what came of notes, and word to you that new notes arrived.

scenes.title: No email yet
scenes.caption: With no email set up, nothing leaves the outbox.
scenes.say: Right now no email account is set up, so every email just sits in an outbox. Nothing leaves. That's fine for Laura.

scenes.title: Works already
scenes.caption: Laura opens her link, leaves notes, and sees results.
scenes.say: You send Laura her link on WhatsApp. She leaves her notes, and sees what came of each one under My notes on the site.

scenes.title: Your side
scenes.caption: Your side needs no email at all.
scenes.say: Your side needs no email either. Each note goes through three gates: done, held for you, or declined with a plain reason.

scenes.title: Built-in safety
scenes.caption: Links hide their secret, and invitations last seven days.
scenes.say: The safety is already built in. Scanners cannot use a link up, invitations last seven days, and turning someone off ends all their links.

scenes.title: Switching on
scenes.caption: About ten minutes for you, and it costs nothing.
scenes.say: Switching email on takes about ten minutes, using a personal Resend account. The free plan allows a hundred emails a day, so Laura's cost nothing.

picture.sub: and the free plan covers it

scenes.title: My pick
scenes.caption: Start with no email. Switch it on later.
scenes.say: So my pick: start with no email, and send Laura her link on WhatsApp. Switch email on later, when you want her to hear back.
